_note: Per-1M-token USD prices used to meter proxied calls and to auto-price POST /v1/track. Every entry carries a source and an as_of date; 'verified' is false until an operator has confirmed the number against the provider's own page. An entry with a cache_hit rate uses it for cached input tokens — ignoring it would overstate a cache-heavy workload badly (DeepSeek's cache-hit rate is ~50x cheaper than cache-miss). A model that is not listed at all is NOT blocked: the call passes through and an alert fires. GET /v1/pricing shows exactly what is loaded.

deepseek-v4-flash.note: DeepSeek announced peak/off-peak billing taking effect 2026-08-16 16:00 UTC; this is the flat published rate. Verify before trusting.

deepseek-flash.source: alias of deepseek-v4-flash, used by the Hermes fleet config
